fusions.name: Last Rake
fusions.desc: A raking pounce that deals 22 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Diseased] for 8 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Hooked Cuff
fusions.desc: A swat with claws that hook in: it deals 4 damage, slows the target by 20% for 2 seconds and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Crevice Squeeze
fusions.desc: Springs you 2 tiles into cover and reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Sure-Footed Crust
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
